item.title: RAmAnuja - who not
item.description:
rAmAnuja misconceptions (Kn with En subtitles)

https://youtu.be/tm2nl9ZkMMc

विस्तारः (द्रष्टुं नोद्यम्)
  • 0:00:04 - 0:00:41: mangalam invocation. Salutations to sadas. Thanks for ritual allowance of time. Joyful intent to speak.
  • 0:00:41 - 0:01:28: vedAntin AchAryas as truth explorers. Good intent, varying success, broad dharma agreement.
  • 0:01:28 - 0:02:30: pramANa-s - AchAryas’ own words, stone inscriptions vs aitihyas & upanyAsa-s. Emphasizing good deeds (यान्य् अस्माकं सुचरितानि).
  • 0:02:30 - 0:04:01: rAmANuja as hRdayavAn and rasikaH. Actions derived from bhagavad(-Atma)-anubhava overflow and tattvAvesha overflow.
  • 0:04:01 - 0:05:06: Misconceptions in aitihyas & upanyAsas (pros and cons). mantra-rahasya tower broadcast myth refuted; no scriptural violations or guru-droha.
  • 0:05:06 - 0:05:54: varNa & jAti stance: liberality up to maximum shAstra allowance. High regard for v4 bhAgavatas. Adherence to traditional intra-jAti strictures.
  • 0:05:54 - 0:08:18: Rigorous personal AchAra (offered arghya even on his last day of life at age 120). Shastric rules as AjnA (command) and anujnA (permission) of God.
  • 0:08:18 - 0:11:13: Expectations from followers: 5 saMskAra-s for vaiShNavatva; prapatti & bhakti for bhagAvatatva; living as 5-kAla-parAyaNa-s; 4-book kAlakShepa. Refutation of “mokSha only via rAmAnuja?” and personal avatAra-claim.
  • 0:11:13 - 0:12:00: Required Adoration of Gods, RShi-s, and pitRs during daily/occasional nitya/ naimittika karma-s. devatAntara-bhajana deprecated beyond that for ekAntin-s.
  • 0:12:00 - 0:13:58: Sharp wit and powerful rhetoric. Proving he was both hRdayavAn + buddhimAn. Opponents in debates reduced to a pitiable state. Refuted ekAtmatA-niShThA (monism) by pointing out the logical contradiction of trying to teach others. Played the role of a joyful answer-sheet corrector.
  • 0:13:58 - 0:21:42: Tradition antiquity details. vaikhAnasa sUtras and pAncharAtra texts (some not quoted in early bhAShyas). Rise of vaidikas over time (14.5B → 4.5B → .5B → .065B → .0002B → 5k). Adhvaryava dominance and the innate vaiShNavism of Yajur Veda (pAncharAtra, vaikhAnasa), early BrAhmaNas, and Upanishads (~4k years ago). Historical backing: Ramayana, Mahabharata (Narayaniya), Heliodorus inscription, bhAgavata cave etchings, and Brahma-sutras. Root of later bhakti movement, intense bhagavad-anubhava, and drAviDa divya-prabandha-s.

rAmAnuja’s contribution - fixed (crypto-)buddhist ideas thumped on vedas (Kn with En subtitles)

विस्तारः (द्रष्टुं नोद्यम्)
  • 0:07 Rise of buddhists buddhus - 2.5k.
  • 0:33 mAdhyamaka-s - 1.5k. shUnya-vivarta-vAda. Gods, veda avidyA.
  • 1:25 Rise of shAnkara-s - 1.5k. nirvisheSha-brahma-vivarta-vAda. Gods, veda avidyA.
  • 2:24 Fits shruti, smRti, sUtra? Ok even if buddhu-origin.
  • 2:42 Similarities acked - gauDapAda, shankara, Anandagiri/ kumArIla . madhva, yAmuna, rAmAnuja. prachChanna bauddha/ vedAntin.
  • 3:48 logical errors - No nirvisheSha / attributeless experience or object. Examples? where’s avidyA? co-eternal?
  • 4:50 sourcing errors - privileging abheda-shrutis. No pre-buddhu application sarpa-rajju nyAya to jagat. (bheda-shrutis, untraceables in case of madhva.)
  • 5:26 mImAMsA errors - lakShaNa. (mAdhva-s too). Coping - 2 Atmans, 2 brahman-s.
  • 5:57 S’s vaiShNavatva. hari-harAbheda. shaivas.
  • 7:09 Rescue. तस्मै रामानुजार्याय नमः परमयोगिने । यः श्रुति-स्मृति-सूत्राणाम् अन्तर् ज्वरम् अशीशमत् ॥
  • 7:25 Conclusion. Truth over Pride. Thanks.
विस्तारः (द्रष्टुं नोद्यम्)
